subject.title: backup create stalls on large installations (4GB+ .openclaw dir)

question: Should OpenClaw solve large native backups with core CLI exclusion/progress controls now, and what protected paths or smart defaults should be part of that contract?
rationale: The bug is real enough to keep open, but the durable fix changes backup scope and restore safety, which requires maintainer intent rather than an automatic duplicate fix PR.

options.title: Review the linked PR as canonical
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/44288 to settle smart defaults, protected paths, manifest/JSON behavior, and real large-backup proof before landing or narrowing it.

options.title: Narrow to explicit controls first
options.body: Accept only explicit `--exclude` or clear-error/progress behavior now, and defer smart defaults until restore completeness expectations are clearer.

options.title: Defer native scope controls
options.body: Keep core backups coarse for now and document ClawHub backup plugins such as keepmyclaw as optional workarounds while leaving this issue open for a later product decision.

recommendation.title: Review the linked PR as canonical
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/44288 to settle smart defaults, protected paths, manifest/JSON behavior, and real large-backup proof before landing or narrowing it.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest history signal on the original backup CLI contract and adjacent helper extraction.
